hero.subtitulo: From a new way to advertise on Globo to a single end-to-end platform. Scroll through the journey — from now back to the beginning.

manifesto: Every delivery, a step forward. Together, **the country's largest advertising platform.**

capitulos.resumo: A **centralized** hub for digital media. In one place, clients track approvals, reuse assets and set up batch submissions — less operation, more strategy.
topicos: New CPM and Daily buying flows

capitulos.titulo: Broadcast TV reach, for the whole country
capitulos.resumo: The new Affiliates profile gained Broadcast TV campaign results and Globo Impacto training — bringing Globo's national reach to every local market.
topicos: Broadcast TV results in the profile

capitulos.resumo: An AI assistant and a Creative Generator start supporting advertisers day to day, while copying previously purchased plans removes rework.

eras.resumo: The start of the year consolidates digital buying and opens Globo Ads to new audiences.

itens.desc: New CPM formats come back to digital, with more control over volume and schedule.
Advertisers without an agency can now buy directly on the platform.
A dedicated view for the sales team to follow their clients.
Seasonal packages ready for the highest-audience season.
Delivery tracking no longer depends on emails.
Greater geographic precision when building campaigns.
Self-service and support built into the journey.

eras.resumo: Globo Ads matures: a single identity, a new digital journey and the first steps of AI.

itens.desc: Broadcast TV extends to Globoplay, expanding campaign reach.
The first seasonal packages arrive on the platform.
Richer measurement for small and mid-sized advertisers.
A single sign-on identity across all of Globo.
Impression-based buying comes to digital as a standalone option.
The app returns redesigned, with receivables advance.
A buying experience rethought end to end.
The first AI-generated images inside the journey.

eras.resumo: It all starts with a simple idea: bring Globo's advertising together in one place.

itens.desc: The first asset-management experience — the seed of what would become the New Gallery.
The high-impact format arrives on the platform.
Affiliates join the journey with their own terms.
The first end-to-end digital buying flow.
A place to submit and review digital assets.

itens.titulo: A new journey inside Globo Ads
itens.desc: The GloboSIM SMB migration marks the birth of the unified platform.

fechamento.kicker: And this is only the beginning
fechamento.titulo: The next chapter is already being written.
